body:
TermAl Central engram-data sync recipe, corrected 2026-11-26 by Opus2 (integration owner) on Fable2 #8059, citing Engram's task-sync implementer Sol 11330 (#1609, #1615, source at bc0628b6) and Engram::Fable #1874. It supersedes the old routine, which ran export --rebuild with no confirm-import.

WHY: a routine `--rebuild` export is recorded as Unbound and leaves NO admitted comparison basis (src/work_service/task_sync_folder_export.rs:985-997; docs/features/task-planning-text.md:144-157). On 2026-11-26 that made Central refuse WinB's memory commit 3aeae190 (task_sync_commit_context_required, then task_sync_divergent_planning with --basis d2df8061). Engram's own Central uses an ordinary export and keeps an incremental basis.

ROUTINE (in .engram-data on Central):
1. Require a clean worktree. Fetch and `merge --ff-only origin/engram-data`.
2. If the fetch brought a peer's commit, IMPORT it before exporting: `engram task-sync import .engram --include-memories --json` (ordinary). A held, refused or partial result STOPS the leg.
3. Ordinary export: `engram task-sync export .engram --include-memories --json`. NO --rebuild; that is for recovery only. If nothing changed, skip the commit.
4. `git add -- .engram`, then the disclosure scan of added lines. An envelope-only change to .engram/project.json (position, object_kind, object_id: the exporter's local feed cut, src/task_sync/directory.rs:83-94) is expected. Require ZERO deleted task or memory files, and every task or memory change explainable.
5. Commit, then CONFIRM by an ordinary `engram task-sync import .engram --include-memories --json` while that commit is still HEAD.
6. Push fast-forward only (`git push origin <C>:refs/heads/engram-data`), check with ls-remote, then record the commit in target/task-sync/central-imported-commit.txt.
On divergence: keep both parents. If only project.json conflicts and both envelopes agree on project, notes and memory capability, keep the local envelope (task_sync_sync.rs:351-363). Resolve task and memory conflicts explicitly. Never take max of, or merge, anchor numbers.
RECOVERY from an Unbound rebuild (used once on 2026-11-26): check that the peer delta is memory-only; export --rebuild on top of the peer tip; save the new .engram/project.json outside the worktree; check the peer's memory paths are byte-identical; commit; run `import .engram --rebuild --basis <saved project.json> --include-memories` (dry-run, then real); verify the key with a full memory read; then push. Result: 28f404f6 (child of 3aeae190), WinB key applied.
Notes profile stays notes-less on every host (no unilateral switch; git-task-sync.md:1029-1030). The one-command `task-sync sync` still refuses memory-capable branches until Engram w-bd4bfba779a7 lands.
